title: Bahasa Inggris Fase C · Bertingkat
subject: inggris
description: Simple past, there is/are, comparatives, question words, a reading about Banten, and telling facts from opinions.
topic: Simple past, there is/are, comparatives, question words, reading (English Fase C)

items.explanation: Go is an irregular verb: go → went → gone.

items.stem: There ___ many books in the library.
items.explanation: Use there are with plural nouns (many books) and there is with one thing.

items.stem: My father works in a hospital. He helps sick people. He is a ....
items.explanation: A doctor works in a hospital and helps sick people.

items.stem: Yesterday I ___ football with my friends.
items.explanation: Yesterday tells us the action is in the past, so we use the past form: played.

hints: Look at the word 'yesterday'. Is it about now or about the past?

items.stem: An elephant is ___ than a cat.
items.explanation: When we compare two things, we use the comparative: big → bigger (double the g, add -er).

items.stem: A: "___ do you live?" B: "I live in Serang."
items.explanation: The answer is a place, so the question word is where.

items.stem:
Read the text.
The Great Mosque of Banten is in Banten Lama, Serang. It was built in the sixteenth century. Next to the mosque there is a tall white tower. Many visitors come to the mosque every day, especially during holidays.
What is next to the mosque?
items.explanation: The text says: "Next to the mosque there is a tall white tower."

items.stem:
Read the text.
The Great Mosque of Banten is in Banten Lama, Serang. It was built in the sixteenth century. Next to the mosque there is a tall white tower. Many visitors come to the mosque every day, especially during holidays.
"Many visitors come to the mosque every day." This sentence shows that the mosque is ....
items.explanation: If many people visit a place every day, the place is popular. The text also says it is from the sixteenth century, so it is not new.

hints: What do we call a place that many people like to visit?

items.explanation: After doesn't, use the base form of the verb: doesn't like.

items.stem: Library rule: Return books within 7 days. Late fee: Rp500 per day. Ani borrowed a book on Monday and returned it on Monday two weeks later. How much does she pay?
items.explanation: Two weeks is 14 days. The first 7 days are free, so she is 14 − 7 = 7 days late. 7 × Rp500 = Rp3.500.

hints: How many days is two weeks?
How many of those days are late?

items.stem: Which sentence gives a good reason to save water?
options: Clean water is limited, and many people still need it.
items.explanation: A reason explains why. Only the first sentence explains why saving water matters.

options: Komodo dragons are the most beautiful animals in the world.
Water boils at 100 °C at sea level.
items.explanation: A fact can be checked. An opinion is what someone thinks or feels. "Most beautiful" is a personal judgement, so it is an opinion.
